rounds.text: Texas hold'em it is, heads-up against the house. Each of us gets two hole cards, then five shared cards come out: the flop (three), the turn and the river, with a betting round before each. You can check, bet or fold, and the best five-card hand from seven cards wins the pot. You have 1,000 chips to start, and we've each put in a 10-chip ante, so there's 20 in the pot. You have Q♥ 10♥, which is a good start. It's your move.
